rule: Colored guides are proposed trajectories for existing screenshot-traced silhouettes, not authenticated lost historical stroke paths. Counterpart is reflected across x=300.

groups.name: Long upper diagonal, hooked fall, and inner notch
groups.description: Tall diagonal climbs left-to-right; hooked return down to lower-left; inner notch curls toward right stem.
groups.caveat: Three-stroke interpretation proposed from screenshot filled contour, not historical vector centerline.

steps.name: Ascending upper sweep
steps.description: Draw from middle-left toward upper-right tip.

steps.name: Bent right return
steps.description: From the top tip descend along right bend into a long diagonal down-left.

steps.name: Short inner notch
steps.description: Add left-to-right inner curl toward the main stem.

groups.name: Angular upper flow with detached lower arc
groups.description: One continuous upper S-folded gesture and separate low arch.
groups.caveat: Prior three-stroke stack was rejected in original design work; preserve flowing upper motion and separate lower sweep.

steps.name: Upper angled fold
steps.description: Sweep across top, fold inward at center, finish lower right in one stroke.

steps.name: Detached lower arc
steps.description: Create shallow rising arc from lower-left to lower-right.

groups.name: Upper angled hook with two descending arms
groups.description: Top upward sweep to a shared right apex followed by two descending arms.
groups.caveat: Shared apex between arms is genuine proposed contact, labels must be offset not moved pen-down point.

steps.name: Upper rising sweep
steps.description: Draw from upper left into pointed upper-right junction.

steps.name: Inner long diagonal
steps.description: Begin at junction, sweep left/down into extended lower-left arm.

steps.name: Descending right arm
steps.description: Return to junction and descend in a smooth near-vertical sweep.
